name: Blue Cash Preferred® Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $0 intro annual fee for the first year, then $95

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR for purchases for the first 12 months from account opening; see current American Express terms.

fx_fee.notes: 2.7% of each transaction after conversion to US dollars.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on other eligible purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back is received as Reward Dollars redeemable for statement credits or at Amazon.com checkout.

signup_bonus.description: Earn $150 cash back after making $3,000 or more in eligible purchases within the first 6 months of Card Membership; offers may vary.

benefits.title: $120 Disney Streaming Credit
benefits.description: Enrollment required; up to $10 in statement credits each month after qualifying purchases at eligible Disney+, Hulu, or ESPN streaming sites.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage on eligible rentals when paid with the card, subject to terms and exclusions.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible purchases against accidental damage or theft for a limited period, subject to terms and exclusions.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Extends eligible manufacturers' warranties on covered purchases, subject to terms and exclusions.

benefits.title: Return Protection
benefits.description: May provide reimbursement for eligible purchases when a merchant will not accept a return, subject to terms and exclusions.

notes: Product name Blue Cash Preferred is not a Network Tier; network_tier is none for Amex network packages. Welcome offers and APR ranges may vary by channel.
